ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous regions occupy the lateral lobes. A low-intensity dark region is concentrated around the central notch extending toward the peduncle. Distinct dark focal spots and linear streaks are distributed across the right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a pixel angle of approximately 60 degrees and a depth of roughly 15% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration map characterized by multiple sharp peaks and deep valleys along the entire continuous trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Fluke lobes follow a convex sweep trajectory from the central notch to the distal tips, which exhibit an acute upward-curving geometry.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular high-contrast pixel clusters (diameters ranging 5-10 pixels) distributed near the central notch and along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High-contrast linear pixel disruptions forming a cross-hatched (X-pattern) set of rake marks on the right lobe, along with several parallel vertical scratches.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant linear rake mark scarring on the right lobe and an irregular, jagged trailing edge profile suggesting prior tissue loss or scarring.
